[EVENT] User is troubleshooting the touchscreen issue with their laptop.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of troubleshooting steps for the touchscreen and stylus pen, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Restart the laptop.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Clean the touchscreen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Disable and re-enable the touchscreen via Device Manager.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Update touchscreen drivers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Check for conflicts with other devices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Calibrate the touchscreen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Reset the stylus pen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Contact the manufacturer or a professional if issues persist.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant asked for more details about the laptop model and stylus pen model to provide specific calibration instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided calibration instructions for the Lenovo Yoga 730, including two methods: through Lenovo's Settings App and through Windows Settings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested checking for firmware updates for the stylus pen and resetting it if applicable.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended running the Windows Touch Diagnostic tool to identify and fix touchscreen issues.
